decision: PROTOCOL ACCEPTABLE WITH SCOPE LIMITS; IMPLEMENTATION AND RESULTS PENDING
comments: Finite physical W/B/current return tolerance only; controller and held-output diagnostics do not have frozen pass thresholds, so no complete closed-loop-state or exact periodic-orbit return may be claimed.
Resource guarantee is absolute net incremental recovery energy <=1 kJ and correction amplitude <=5 kW, not a positive-only or absolute-throughput budget.
One shared nominal warmup checkpoint per numerical integration step is required; no tau/ramp-specific prewarm or calibration may be characterized as the same held-out test.
All extrema are numerical integration extrema, not mathematically certified interstep continuous maxima.
Final-window sampling must be phase-matched on the actual continuing grid/PWM clocks.
Two identical healthy forks must be bitwise identical; hash and complete state comparisons must include all control state.
